notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary regional interaction source-region snapshot surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies send-time source-region capture across deferred callback servicing, ordinary interaction payload and tag delivery, producer and transportation metadata, suppression after a source-region mutation becomes disjoint, restored-overlap delivery, conveyed source-region designators, and independent region and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional interaction region creation, publication, subscription, source-region mutation, send, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional interaction source-region snapshot declarations
